```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
import sqlite3
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```

```{python}
sqlite_file = 'lahmansbaseballdb.sqlite'
conn = sqlite3.connect(sqlite_file)
```

## Load managers table

Take a few minutes to load the managers table into a polars dataframe

```{python}
q = """
    SELECT 
      playerID, 
      G as 'games managed', 
      W as 'wins',
      (CAST(W as float) / G) as 'Win %'
    FROM managers
"""
managers_df = pl.read_database(q, conn)
managers_df
```

```{python}
q = """
    SELECT 
          playerID, 
          teamID, 
          SUM(G) as 'games managed', 
          SUM(W) as 'wins',
          ROUND((CAST(SUM(W) as float) / SUM(G)), 3) as 'Win %' 
    FROM managers
"""
result = pl.read_database(q, conn)
result

```


```{python}
q = """
    SELECT 
          playerID, 
          teamID, 
          MAX(yearID) AS year,  
          SUM(G) AS games_managed, 
          SUM(W) AS wins,
          SUM(L) AS losses,
          ROUND(CAST(SUM(W) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(G),0), 3) AS win_pct
    FROM managers
    --WHERE G > 100 -- This is a comment
  GROUP BY playerID
    HAVING SUM(G) > 100
        AND MAX(yearID) > 1800
  ORDER BY win_pct DESC
  LIMIT 100

"""
result = pl.read_database(q, conn)

with pl.Config(tbl_rows=50):
  display(result)
```

```{python}
sampled = result.sample(n=50, with_replacement=False, seed=42)
display(sampled)
```
